basic_info.description: Welcome to 3236-3238 San Bruno Avenue, a well-maintained 1953 duplex located at the crossroads of the Portola District and Visitacion Valley. Each unit offers two bedrooms and one bathroom, with identical layouts featuring bright, spacious interiors and a functional kitchen with a dining area that opens directly to the backyard. The property includes a large garage with space for two cars and separate laundry hookups for each unit. The expansive backyard provides a great outdoor space for relaxing, entertaining, or gardening. Situated in a convenient San Francisco location, this home is just minutes from public transportation, freeways 101 and 280, local shops, restaurants, grocery stores, and neighborhood amenities. Whether you're an investor seeking rental income or a homeowner looking to live in one unit and rent out the other, this versatile property offers both comfort and opportunity in a well-connected urban setting.
